title: Biking to 3400 metres!
text: Jaime is a great guy speaking English perfectly. It was an amazing adventure to bike up to 3400 metres and see Africa from the Sierra Nevada! Strongly recommended
author: guidob541

title: DO IT!
text:
Jaime is a fantastic guide with a lot of knowledge about the surroundings and on top of that, he is a great guy. 
The biketrip was amazing and can be done by the most people.
author: 295tueb

title: Excellent day activity in Granada
text: Had a blast! Jaime was very professional and helpful. The Sierra Nevada was beautiful with breathtaking views! A must do in Granada.
author: nycbk13

title: Lovely biking experience
text: My partner and I did the private off road e bike tour and we had an amazing time! Our guide Maria was super friendly and knowledgable and she was able to pitch the speed and difficulty for the abilities of the group. The scenery was breathtaking! There were some exhilarating downhill segments. Average fitness level can complete this ride, you will need a certain level of confidence riding a bike as the path was uneven and gravelly in some places, however the sturdy mountain ebikes were more than able to handle the terrain. 10/10
author: alvaghb

title: Fantastic E-MTB tour with great views and great guidance by Maria and service by Jose
text:
Well organized including pick up from hotel, good quality MTB, snack and water included. Fantastic ride and view on gravel roads. Supported by Maria and Jose who are very warm and friendly. Nice arrival via the narrow Granada city center streets. 
Nice surprise that a video was made and shared via Whatsapp.
author: realmad1971

title: Great bike ride tour
text: Beautiful views and fantastic guides, but not for the faint of heart! This was an exhilarating ride down the mountain dirt roads on e-bikes. Plenty of water and snacks were provided, along with a great video showing our route and some pictures at the end of the trip. We had the option of cycling an extra 8km into Granada which was a nice way to end the day.
author: rayn0494

title: Highlight stuff
text: Our family of four spent 10 days in Spain.  We saw some amazing places, but easily the highlight of our trip was the e-bike trip in the Sierra Nevadas.  Maria and Jose were fantastic!  The scenery is spectacular and the bikes are ridiculously easy to ride.  We did 50K and could have gone further but it was getting close to 32C so we just decided to call it a day.  Jose took some great photos and did a bit of a highlight video which was great.  So take it from me, you don’t need to ride one-handed while filming with the other. author: 994timm

title: Sierra Nevada E-Bike tour
text: I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. If you enjoy the outdoors, mountains, and exercise then this is for you! Maria and Jose were amazing hosts and we felt safe and taken care of all day. It’s the perfect way to really experience the beautiful outdoors of the Sierra Nevada and of Andalucía. The bikes were comfortable and easy to use (it was our first time on E-Bikes) The bonus was riding through the Albaicin and into the city at the end of the tour. author: dannells2015

title: Such an incredible, memorable experience!
text:
We had originally planned to ride from the Veleta Peak, but weather as it is had the snow level too high for the planned trip. Maria and Jose were super accommodating and made another route for us which we really enjoyed.

The bikes were in great shape (and boy that assist really helps!) and they had all the equipment we might have needed.

author: Rachel A

title: Great trip with Jamie
text: Brilliant experience - see a new side to Spain by exploring the Sierra Nevada valley. Plenty of photo stops and relaxing time at the top where the views are amazing. Great attentive guide highly recommend.
author: 164jakiac
